details.description: A pale, tapered load rib breaks above the dark crown; its edge is chipped and the face carries shallow pits.
details.affects: Crown silhouette and bone-to-stone value separation.

details.description: The crown gathers several pale ribs against a thick charcoal cap; the joints are irregular and the central cap is darker than the bone.
details.affects: Top silhouette, structural hierarchy, and arch depth.

details.description: Large dark blocks step around the outer curve with broken corners; a pale rib tracks just inside the stone.
details.affects: Approach silhouette and readable arch thickness.

details.description: This crop is empty cool-gray background outside the structure. Keep the exterior contour isolated and do not add floating ornament here.
details.affects: Silhouette separation and uncluttered exterior edge.

details.description: A square bronze clamp overlaps the pale vertical rib and dark stone backing. A round fastener sits on the face; the collar has a raised upper and lower lip.
details.affects: Construction contact and material contrast.

details.description: Two dark red-brown flexible lines leave the collar underside and follow the bone rib down; both ends remain visibly socketed.
details.affects: Hardware attachment and one-sided accent rhythm.

details.description: Uneven ivory teeth hang from the inner crown, varying in length and spacing while stopping above the middle walking lane.
details.affects: Inner opening silhouette and scale cue.

details.description: An opaque oxblood web sits behind the front ribs. Thick branching strands frame several dark openings instead of filling the throat with a flat sheet.
details.affects: Layered depth, color accent, and visible aperture.

details.description: Dark, chunky arch stones alternate with pale ribs along the right curve; some blocks are fractured and sit at slightly different depth.
details.affects: Asymmetrical structural rhythm and depth.

details.description: Several pale pointed spurs project inward from the side and crown, with the longest kept outside the standing center lane.
details.affects: Threatening side silhouette without blocking traversal.

details.description: A pale upright rib shows an elongated natural opening with softened chipped edges; a bronze clamp wraps its base.
details.affects: Bone identity and collar attachment point.

details.description: The center remains a deep nearly-black void behind the layered web and teeth; preserve a tall, open, walk-through aperture.
details.affects: Functional aperture and strong value hierarchy.

details.description: A tiny warm amber light is visible deep in the throat, occupying very little area against the dark void.
details.affects: Far-distance focal point and depth cue.

details.description: Thin red-brown branches cross and fork through the left side of the membrane, leaving large negative openings.
details.affects: Organic repetition, membrane depth, and color variation.

details.description: A long reddish cable runs diagonally over the lateral bone and terminates at a bronze plate fixed into the basalt course.
details.affects: Attachment continuity and asymmetrical hardware placement.

details.description: Broad dark stone blocks anchor the vertical structure to the ground, with small chips gathered at the foot of the ribs.
details.affects: Stable base silhouette and floor contact.

details.description: Pale ribs widen into the footing and meet separate dark blocks at ground level; no unsupported bone ends hover above the floor.
details.affects: Believable load transfer and grounded silhouette.

details.description: The floor is charcoal and mostly matte, with narrow broken warm highlights close to the structure rather than an even glossy reflection.
details.affects: Footing contact, approach readability, and surface roughness contrast.

details.description: Angular basalt fragments and a few pale bone chips collect against the side feet while leaving the center approach clear.
details.affects: Grounded transitions and low-level framing.

details.description: The oblique edge reveals a short continuation of stone and bone depth behind the front face; hidden rear geometry is intentionally lower-detail and inferred.
details.affects: Structural depth without overbuilding unseen faces.

authoringInstruction: Zone stubs were classified from each saved crop. Every observed feature maps to a component local feature or material local override; the three negative-space constraints are intentional and preserve silhouette and traversal.
